ringBefore.line: 🔍 Sanne has been turning over a slender fast-growing tree with feathery leaves and long hanging pods for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Sanne came back with 412 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Raj is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 81/100)
Raj and Elif lingered over the fire together.
💧 The cistern won't cover today — the hall's call, no vote needed: half rations until the water runs come back.
🤒 Sanne is back on their feet — the fever ran its course.
— DAY 174 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
💬 Joaquim says: "The voice said 'north.' Just... north. I don't know what it means."
Joaquim Pinto reads the sky: rain tomorrow, mild.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
